index_record.dataset_generation_caption: The figure presents a comprehensive architectural framework for AI-enabled smart spaces, structured as a 3D cube with labeled faces representing key functional domains: Sensors & Actuators (left), Storage & Processing (right), Applications & Services (top), and Communications & Networks (bottom). At the center of the cube is a core module labeled 'AI-Enabled Smart Spaces,' depicted with an AI gear icon and a human silhouette, symbolizing human-centric intelligent environments. This central module is connected to four primary functional blocks arranged in a cyclic workflow: 'Sensing & Monitoring' (gray rounded rectangle), 'Data Transmission' (orange rounded rectangle), 'Storage & Computing' (green rounded rectangle), and 'Applications & Services' (purple rounded rectangle). These blocks form a closed loop: Sensing & Monitoring feeds into Data Transmission, which connects to Storage & Computing, which then supports Applications & Services, which in turn feeds back into Sensing & Monitoring. A dashed arrow from Data Transmission points to a cloud-shaped icon labeled 'Cloud Center (Data Storage & Analytics),' indicating optional or auxiliary cloud-based processing. The 'Users' block, represented by a group of stylized human icons, is positioned between Storage & Computing and Applications & Services, emphasizing user interaction. On the left face, under 'Sensors & Actuators,' various physical devices are listed with icons: Motion Sensors, Wireless Sensing, Air Quality Sensors, Ambient Sensors, Thermal Cameras, Cameras, Lighting, HVAC, Switch, and Door. On the right face, 'Storage & Processing' includes icons for Device, Edge & Cloud Computing, and Processors & Computers (CPU, GPU, TPU). The bottom face, 'Communications & Networks,' displays logos for various connectivity technologies: 4G LTE, 5G, NB-IoT, LTE-M, WiFi, LoRaWAN, Zigbee, Z-Wave, RFID, and Bluetooth. The top face, 'Applications & Services,' features five application icons with labels: User-Centric Assistance (person with heart and brain), Health Monitoring (heart rate monitor), Autonomous Decision (AI checkmark and cross), Energy Optimization (lightbulb with plug), and Improved Space Functionality (gear with upward arrow). The entire diagram is enclosed in a dashed border, and a text box on the right side of the central workflow states 'Creation of Smart Spaces for Enhanced Indoor Spaces,' summarizing the overall goal. The visual style uses distinct colors for each functional block (gray, orange, green, purple) and employs standard icons for clarity and accessibility.
